title: FOUNDER | Melanie Perkins - Canva
text:
FOUNDER | Melanie Perkins - Canva
Melanie Perkins is one of the greatest female visionaries in the world. Together with her boyfriend Cliff Obrecht, two kids from Perth tried to take on some of the biggest companies in the world. This episode shows the unlikely pairing of a perfectionist in Melanie and the boy-next-door style of Cliff coming together to create the world's most-used design platform. Now with 135 million users worldwide, Canva makes graphic design accessible to everyone, everywhere. But growth comes with a hefty [...] company, Canva. Just 32 years old and worth billions, Melanie Perkins is proof
that dreams can come true. And for her,
that dream was Canva. [Melanie]
Canva makes it really easy for you to take your idea
and turn that into a design, even if you've had absolutely
no design experience. Because we think
that everyone has ideas,
because they do. [chuckles] And we want them to be able
to take those ideas
and to express them visually. [Cameron]
Design is an incredibly [...] important tool, and for a long time
it was something that only professionals
could access. Giving people a tool which
lets them access that design, actually unlocks a huge amount
of opportunities for them. [Melanie]
Because we were born
on the Internet, we were able to completely
reimagine what it could be like. [Scott]
Melanie is possibly the most
visionary person I've met. She has a belief
that she can see the future, and she can totally will it
into existence by sheer force
